name: Exodus
tagline: God rescues and dwells with his people
author: Traditionally Moses.
date: Traditionally dated to the time of Moses. Scholars differ on the date of the exodus itself, often placed in the 1400s or 1200s BC.
setting: Israel in Egyptian slavery, then in the wilderness at Mount Sinai.
theme: God redeems Israel from slavery, makes a covenant with them at Sinai, and comes to live among them in the tabernacle.

outline.label: Israel in Egypt and the birth of Moses
The golden calf and the renewal of the covenant

christInBook: Moses the deliverer, the Passover lamb, the manna, the water from the rock, the tabernacle, and the priesthood all point to Jesus. John 1:14 says the Word “tabernacled” among us, and Paul calls Christ our Passover lamb (1 Corinthians 5:7).
howToRead: Exodus has two halves: redemption (chapters 1-18) and covenant and worship (chapters 19-40). Notice that God rescues Israel before he gives the law. Obedience in this book always follows grace.
